name: Timestamp.FromISO
meaning: Parses an ISO 8601 timestamp into a FileMaker timestamp. Date part via Date.FromISO; time via Time.FromISO when a "T" is present, else 0. Returns "? Not a valid ISO 8601 timestamp" plus input when either part errors.
open_question: Invalid input returns a "?" string; empty input flow follows Date.FromISO. name: Timestamp.ToISO

name: WriteNumber
meaning: Writes out a number below 10 in English (blank for 0, then one..nine); numbers of 10 or more are returned as digits.

name: CustomList
meaning: Builds a list by running a calculation expression for each integer from Start to End (use [n] for the counter). Works by building a long string of Let/Evaluate calls in blocks (1700 values at a time, fewer on Go, Server and Web) and evaluating it; limited to 500,000 values. Returns "" for bad Start or End, "?" or a debug error text on error. Uses repeating variables $CLn, $CLExecute, $CLRemainder.
